ios-actions|Edit menus.summary: A Plenix edit menu on iOS is the system edit menu (UIEditMenuInteraction), never a copy of it: it opens with the standard gestures on a text or content selection, lays out horizontally for touch and vertically for a pointer, moves aside when it would cover the selection, and works with VoiceOver and the keyboard. Plenix decides only what it adds: a few custom commands with short verb labels, placed beside the related system commands, and only the commands that apply now, with undo and redo behind them. The system draws the menu, so its look stays Apple’s; the Plenix rows show the Plenix menu tokens for comparison and for a Plenix-drawn selection bar, such as on a canvas that is not text.
